# Collapse internal spaces

## Goal

`collapseSpaces` should collapse runs of spaces within a line down to a
single space, instead of returning the input unchanged.

## Approach

Replace runs of the space character (`/ {2,}/g`) with a single space.
Only the space character is collapsed — other whitespace (tabs, newlines)
is left untouched, matching the function's name and doc comment.

- [x] no behaviour change for input with no repeated spaces
